summary: Preinstall script fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: @or-sdk/library-categories@0.2.6 declares `scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs"` in package.json. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated with hex-suffixed renamed identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, etc.) and inline string-dictionary lookups. On install it either invokes a locally installed `bun`, or downloads the Bun runtime binary v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then execFileSync's it against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~728KB `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle protected by a rotated-string-array obfuscator (WV8StW rotator over lookup array `n7gIxM`). The package ships no `binding.gyp`, no native sources, and no documented use for an alternate language runtime — the stated purpose is an SDK library-categories module. The file name `math_init.js` does not correspond to any advertised functionality. Executing a heavily obfuscated bundle under a freshly downloaded second-language runtime on every `npm install`, via an obfuscated loader, is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern; the obfuscation prevents inspection of what the payload does on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
